messages:
Marta S.: Passing Kyra (trial) to CS — quick summary: 14-day trial ends in 3 days, usage dropped after day 5 (avg ~12 reqs/day). Main asks: 1) Okta SSO (SAML) is blocking onboarding, 2) Private-eval package for PII (quote needed), 3) small tokenization mismatch causing name splits in responses (see snippet). Contact: sam@kyra.ai (PST). Dealsheet: https://redwood.co/deals/KY-433. Please own sales follow-up until handoff complete.

Olivia CSM: Thanks Marta — looping in support & eng. I'll run a health triage and schedule a kickoff for tomorrow 10:00am PST (tentative). Flagging account: SSO-block = true, renewal_risk = medium-high if unresolved. @Raj (Support) can you please open a support ticket to collect Okta metadata? I'll send the pre-kickoff checklist to Sam.

Raj (Support): Creating ticket now. Ticket #SUP-3221. Sam — can you upload Okta SAML metadata or provide admin access? Needed fields: SAML metadata XML or direct SP/ACS values. SP entityID: https://private.redwood/kyra/sp, ACS: https://private.redwood/kyra/acs. @Evan (Eng) can you take a look at the tokenization repro?

Evan (Eng): Thanks — quick Qs: are they on hosted trial or private eval? If private, infra lead needs looped in. I'll try to reproduce the tokenization issue. Repro snippet for eng: 
```python
payload = {"prompt": "Customer name: 'Dr. Ana María-Santos'\nResponse:", "max_tokens": 30}
# model: redwood-3b-quant
# expected: single tokenization on compound names
```
Post the minimal failing sample and anonymized dataset if possible.

Marta S.: They're on hosted trial (starter-eval). Sam confirmed Okta is their IdP. Timezone: PST; Sam can do 10:00am PST. Dealsheet notes PII concerns. I'll follow up on contract/PO items.

Olivia CSM: I'll send the pre-kickoff template now and create tasks. Pre-kickoff checklist: - Collect SAML metadata (SUP-3221) - Provide anonymized tokenization sample - Confirm data residency & PII requirements - Prepare Private-eval quote - Schedule kickoff + enablement session. I'll own scheduling + checklist.

Onboard Bot: Ticket SUP-3221 created and playbook "ssoconfig_v1" initiated.

Raj (Support): SUP-3221 assigned to Raj. Sam, please upload metadata link or paste XML into the ticket. Target to gather by EOD 2024-05-09.

Evan (Eng): Looked at Marta's logs (pasted in thread). Likely whitespace/normalization edge-case in tokenizer. Quick mitigation: set tokenizer.normalize_whitespace = True in runtime config and re-run a sample. If still failing, ENG will prepare a small patch. Creating eng task ENG-6789 and aiming for initial triage by 2024-05-09.

Olivia CSM: Owners & next steps recap: - Olivia: schedule kickoff + run enablement (owner) — kickoff tentative 2024-05-10 10:00 PST - Raj: collect SAML metadata via SUP-3221 — due 2024-05-09 EOD - Evan: eng triage ENG-6789 — initial triage by 2024-05-09 - Marta: sales follow-ups (PO/contract/quote) - Renewal risk: set MEDIUM-HIGH if SSO not resolved before trial end (2024-05-12). I'll update account health dashboard and add notes.

Marta S.: Thanks — Sam will bring Okta admin access to kickoff. I'll also send a ballpark private-eval cost estimate before EOD.

Sam (Kyra): Hi all — I'll upload the SAML metadata to the ticket now and join the kickoff. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Olivia CSM: Perfect — I'll post the calendar invite shortly and mark tasks in the tracker. Closing this thread once SUP-3221 and ENG-6789 are in-progress. :thumbsup:
